not_claimed: coverage or representativeness of unregistered, infinite, natural, deployed, or real-world ecologies
universal adequacy of a 4096-member sample for arbitrary rare subsets
architecture discovery, ranking, performance, or external validity
proved: exact complete census of the registered 2^17 ecology product
zero census selection bias and sampling uncertainty within that product
prospectively committed SRSWOR draw and exact inclusion probabilities
zero SRSWOR design bias for every fixed registered bounded outcome vector
exact finite-population design variance and unbiased variance estimator
realized errors and preregistered coordinate-coverage diagnostics

theorems.statement: The unique full census includes every member of the registered finite product once, hence every registered-population total has zero selection bias and zero sampling uncertainty.

theorems.scope: the frozen finite population and probability design
theorems.statement: Conditional on independent uniform partial-Fisher--Yates offsets, every n-subset is equiprobable and the Horvitz--Thompson/sample mean is design-unbiased for every fixed bounded outcome vector.
The exact design variance is (1-n/N)S^2/n and replacing S^2 by sample s^2 gives an unbiased design-variance estimator.
Axis, pair-cell, Hamming, and rare-niche coverage diagnose the realized sample but do not substitute for outcome-independent probability selection or justify external-universe inference.
